title: 第1020章 再得黑星碎片回到雪城第1019章 归还人情了断因果
content_zh:
“多谢楚小友！”
太上长老连声道谢，挣扎着坐起身来。
经过楚峰这么一救治，他感觉到自己的伤势已然恢复了大半，整个人轻松了许多，不再像之前那般沉重。
“前辈，你体内伤势虽修复了不少，但本源亏损严重，寿元无法补回来。
这段时间还需以静养为主，切莫与人动手，否则寿元还会减少，甚至当场暴毙！”
楚峰严肃提醒。
实在是他的身体太虚了，即便是有造化之力，也无法将他的本源补回来。
“那楚小友可否联系你师尊，请她赐下一枚延寿丹，我万兽门愿意以重宝交换！”
万兽门门主连忙说道。
太上长老可是他们万兽门的顶梁柱。
一旦他死了，整个万兽门恐怕都会陷入危机之中。
“不是我不想帮你们，只是我暂时无法联系到我师尊，只能她单方面联系我。
我也不知道她什么时候会联系我。”
万门主听完，脸色顿时垮了下来。
太上长老倒是看的开一些。
“生死有命，我能多苟活几年已经足够了……”
他摆了摆手。
“其实，也不是没有办法，我与药神谷有些交情，万门主可以去药神谷求药！”
说完，他翻手取出一枚空白玉简，贴在额头，将求延寿丹的事情烙印其中，并附上自己的元神烙印气息。
“万门主，你拿着这个，去南境药神谷找宋燕长老，她会帮你的。”

楚峰把玉简递过去。
万门主接过玉简，神色又是惊喜又是尴尬。
“楚小友，实不相瞒，三年前我去过药神谷，结果连门都没有进去……”
说这话时，他不由得一阵低落。
自己堂堂一门之主，结果连对方的门都没进去。
可他却没有办法，谁让他是求药的呢。
楚峰看出他眼底的不甘和失落。
“这次不一样，玉简上有我的元神烙印，你直接给宋燕长老，她会帮忙的。
不过报酬方面要你们自己准备，这点我帮不上忙。”
万门主猛地抬头。
“真的？！”
楚峰点头。
万门主二话不说，当场朝楚峰深深鞠了一躬，然后转身离去。
茅草屋里顿时安静了下来。
“前辈，如果没有其他事，那我便告辞了！”
content_en:
"Thank you, little friend Chu!"
The Supreme Elder thanked him repeatedly and struggled to sit up.
After Chu Feng's treatment, he felt that most of his injuries had recovered, and he felt much more relaxed, no longer as heavy as before.
"Senior, although your internal injuries have been repaired a lot, your original source has been severely damaged and your longevity cannot be replenished.
During this period, you still need to focus on resting, and don't do anything with others, otherwise your lifespan will be reduced, and you may even die suddenly on the spot! "
Chu Feng reminded seriously.
His body is really too weak, and even with the power of creation, he cannot restore his original strength.
"Then little friend Chu, can you contact your master and ask her to give you a life-extending pill? We, the Ten Thousand Beasts Sect, are willing to exchange the precious treasure for it!"
The master of the Ten Thousand Beasts Sect said quickly.
The Supreme Elder is the backbone of their Ten Thousand Beasts Sect.
Once he dies, the entire Ten Thousand Beasts Sect may be in crisis.
"It's not that I don't want to help you, it's just that I can't contact my master for the time being, so she can only contact me unilaterally.
I don't know when she will contact me. "
After hearing this, Master Wan's face suddenly fell.
The Supreme Elder is more open-minded.
"Life or death is a matter of fate. It's enough for me to survive for a few more years..."
He waved his hand.
"Actually, it's not impossible. I have some friendship with Yao Shen Valley. Master Wan can go to Yao Shen Valley to ask for medicine!"
After saying that, he turned over his hand and took out a blank jade slip, put it on his forehead, imprinted the matter of asking for the longevity pill into it, and added the imprint of his own soul.
"Master Wan, take this and go to the Medicine God Valley in the south to find Elder Song Yan. She will help you."
Chu Feng handed over the jade slip.
Sect Master Wan took the jade slip with a look of surprise and embarrassment.
"Little friend Chu, to be honest, I went to Yao Shen Valley three years ago, but I didn't even get in..."
When he said this, he couldn't help but feel depressed.
He was the proud master of his own sect, but in the end he couldn't even enter the other party's door.
But he had no choice but to ask for medicine.
Chu Feng saw the unwillingness and loss in his eyes.
"This time is different. The jade slip has my soul imprint on it. You can give it directly to Elder Song Yan and she will help.
However, you have to prepare the remuneration yourself, I can't help you with that. "
Sect Leader Wan suddenly raised his head.
"Really?!"
Chu Feng nodded.
Without saying a word, Master Wan bowed deeply to Chu Feng on the spot, then turned and left.
The thatched house suddenly became quiet.
"Senior, if there is nothing else, I will take my leave!"
